_about: BeatBall roster data. One object per team-season, ~10 players each. Fill `stats`, `eligible`, `accolades`, and `capPct` from legit sources (stats from a dataset; salary from Spotrac/Basketball-Reference or balldontlie contract fields). PRICE is a REAL FACT stored per player as cap share — it is NOT derived from stats. Strength = what you get; capPct = what you pay. Their independence is the whole game.

_salaryCaps._note: Season salary cap in millions, published fact (~45 rows once, fill from Basketball-Reference). capPct = player_salary / cap_that_season. You store capPct, not raw dollars, so eras are comparable.

_fieldGuide.stats: The 8 engine inputs. Keys must match exactly: pts, tpm (3PM), reb, ast, stl, blk, fg (as a decimal e.g. 0.520), to.
_fieldGuide.capPct: Salary that season as a share of the league cap (salary / seasonCap). A REAL FACT, independent of stats — this is what the $100M budget buys. Store this, never a strength-derived price.
_fieldGuide.eligible: Array of positions the player can fill without penalty, e.g. ["PG","SG"]. Editorial/hand-tagged — not in most stat feeds.
_fieldGuide.accolades: Defensive-only, for the awards patch. Allowed values: "DPOY", "ALLDEF1", "ALLDEF2". Empty array [] for everyone else (the common case).
_fieldGuide.shape: Curation tag for QA only (not read by the engine). One of: superteam, top-heavy, two-star, one-star, balanced, outlier.
_fieldGuide._todo: Present on rows still to be filled. Delete it once the row is complete.
